gallery.name: Starter Parkour
gallery.desc: A rising star-run: four steps, four stars, a scoreboard payoff

gallery.name: Tiny Arena
gallery.desc: A walled pit where entering wakes the spawner

gallery.name: Glow Circuit
gallery.desc: A kart lap-race: the gate times every lap, two checkpoints keep you honest

gallery.name: The Glowlands
gallery.desc: A three-mission Play Set: light the path, open the vault, win the trial

gallery.name: Nightfall Crown
gallery.desc: A boss-arena Play Set under a living sky: face the crown, depose it, loot the vault

gallery.name: The Deepvault
gallery.desc: A co-op dungeon crawl: clear three chambers of foes, depose the boss, loot the vault

gallery.name: Twin Trials
gallery.desc: A 2-player Play Set: player 2 joins automatically — stand together to open the vault, clear the arena as a team

gallery.name: The Gatekeeper's Vault
gallery.desc: A logic-puzzle Play Set: an OR-gate door, an AND-gate that needs the chest AND three stars, then the treasure vault

gallery.name: Skyward Steps
gallery.desc: A puzzle-platformer: jump the gaps, ride the trampoline to the sky-ledge, grab the star, and the gate opens the vault

gallery.name: Tidewater Run
gallery.desc: A boat voyage: cast off, sail the lake through three ring gates past bobbing barrels, and loot the treasure island

gallery.name: Aether Ruins
gallery.desc: A three-stage adventure: destroy the sentry and clear the wave, teleport to the key-star, and loot the vault — checkpoints between

gallery.name: The Locked Depths
gallery.desc: A key-and-lock dungeon: cross the lava for the gold key, slip past the sentry for the silver, unlock the vault — checkpoints throughout

gallery.name: Skybreak Run
gallery.desc: A cannon-jump course over the void: fire between islands, smash breakable walls for secrets, and blast up to the vault

gallery.name: The Gauntlet
gallery.desc: A wave-survival arena: clear the walkers while dodging charging brutes and a sentry turret, then loot the vault

gallery.name: Bladeworks
gallery.desc: A skill trial: time the sweeping blades, flank the shielder to open its gate, then dodge the charger to the vault

gallery.name: The Warded Hall
gallery.desc: A priority-target fight: a mender drone keeps a shielder-and-charger line alive, so hunt down the healer to drop the vault ward — retreat to the regen field when hurt

gallery.name: Shiftworks
gallery.desc: A shifting-floor traversal gauntlet: ride the conveyors, sprint the crumbling tiles before they drop, time the sweeping blade, then bounce to the star that opens the vault

gallery.name: The Warden's Locks
gallery.desc: A pressure-plate puzzle vault: weigh down the latch plate to open the first lock, press BOTH plates to trip the counter on the second, then claim the vault
